diagnosis: Customer is asking about the retirement timeline for v1 reporting endpoints. KB-0007 confirms the v1 reporting endpoints will stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01 and points to a v2 migration.
reply: The v1 reporting endpoints are scheduled to stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01. We recommend migrating to the v2 endpoints, which return the same fields but use a paginated envelope. The full timeline is available in our knowledge base article kb-0007. Please let us know if you need further assistance with the migration.
